name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. provides electronic manufacturing services. The company offers consumer electronics, including smartphones, feature phones, wearable devices, televisions, game consoles, set-top boxes, and audio systems; cloud and networking products comprising routers, servers, edge computing, data centers, and satellite communications and other related equipment; electronic computing equipment, such as desktop computers, laptops, tablets, multi-function devices and printers; and connectors, precision optical components, lenses, electronic components, semiconductor products, and automotive electronic parts.
